Germany is home to several of the world's largest and most influential medical technology and device companies, including Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun, Fresenius Medical Care, Carl Zeiss Meditec, Biotronik, and Dräger. These industry leaders specialize in everything from diagnostic imaging and dialysis to surgical tools and patient monitoring systems. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:Medical_technology_companies_of_Germany)

- **Siemens Healthineers:** Headquartered in Erlangen, it is a global giant specializing in medical imaging (MRI, CT scanners), laboratory diagnostics, and advanced clinical IT. [](https://www.zoominfo.com/top-lists/top-manufacturing-medical-companies-in-DE)

- **B. Braun:** Based in Melsungen \[0.1\], this major firm produces infusion and nutrition therapies, surgical instruments, and core sterile tubing systems \[0.1\].

- **Fresenius Medical Care:**

Located in Bad Homburg, it is the world's leading provider of products and services dedicated to chronic kidney failure, specifically dialysis equipment.

- **Carl Zeiss Meditec:** Operating out of Jena, this division of the Zeiss Group focuses heavily on ophthalmology and microsurgery medical devices, including diagnostic lasers and surgical microscopes. [](https://www.chemeurope.com/en/companies/medical-technology/germany/order_tc/)

- **Biotronik:** Headquartered in Berlin, this multinational biomedical company specializes in cardiac pacemakers, implantable defibrillators, and vascular intervention products. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Category:Medical_technology_companies_of_Germany)

- **Dräger:** Based in Lübeck, Dräger manufactures critical care and safety devices, being an exceptional market leader in ventilation and anesthesia technology. [](https://www.chemeurope.com/en/companies/medical-technology/germany/order_tc/)

- **Karl Storz:** Headquartered in Tuttlingen (a global hub for medical technology), this family-owned company is a pioneer in endoscopic instruments and video imaging systems for minimally invasive surgery. [](https://bimedis.com/manufacturers/germany)
